newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends down, but well off lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends down, but well off lows.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar ended lower, but well off earlier lows seen as it reacted to a slide in New York.
By the close front month October was 80 cents down at $327.50, compared with a low of $326.50. October was the most active contract with 581 of 1,003 lots done.
Traders said that the day's volume was greatly inflated by against actuals trades and some crosses.
London's fall had more to do with New York, than with any bearish sentiment in London, they said. But they were hoping for a boost from New York.
